T8.1.ref: SELECT device_owner, COUNT(*) AS pings, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 10 THEN 'High' WHEN COUNT(*) >= 1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS suspicion FROM tower_pings WHERE tower_id = 'RRO-17' AND ts >= '2026-12-12 18:00:00' GROUP BY device_owner;

T8.2.ref: SELECT device_owner, COUNT(CASE WHEN tower_id = 'RRO-17' THEN 1 END) AS at_farm_area, COUNT(CASE WHEN tower_id <> 'RRO-17' THEN 1 END) AS elsewhere FROM tower_pings WHERE ts >= '2026-12-12 18:00:00' GROUP BY device_owner;

T8.3.ref: SELECT device_owner FROM tower_pings WHERE tower_id = 'RRO-17' AND ts >= '2026-12-12 18:00:00' INTERSECT SELECT from_name FROM upi_payments WHERE to_name = 'Green Acres Farm Stays';

T8.4.ref: SELECT person_name FROM gate_log WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-12-12 17:30:00' AND '2026-12-12 18:30:00' UNION SELECT rider_name FROM cab_rides WHERE pickup = 'The Grand Residency' AND booked_at BETWEEN '2026-12-12 17:30:00' AND '2026-12-12 18:30:00';

T8.5.ref: SELECT person_name FROM gate_log WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-12-12 17:30:00' AND '2026-12-12 18:30:00' UNION ALL SELECT rider_name FROM cab_rides WHERE pickup = 'The Grand Residency' AND booked_at BETWEEN '2026-12-12 17:30:00' AND '2026-12-12 18:30:00';
